modules.name: Session Architecture
modules.description: Switch between roleplay, where your avatar remains yours, and Matrix, where EiDOS authors the cast in chapters.

controls.name: session_mode
controls.label: Session Mode
controls.description: Roleplay: you own your avatar. Matrix: EiDOS authors the whole fictional cast, then offers six chapter directions. No automatic multi-chapter loop.

controls.name: matrix_words
controls.label: Matrix Chapter Words
controls.description: Approximate chapter prose length in Matrix. Independent of RP Narrative Mass and trace budget; output limits still apply.

modules.name: Polyphony
modules.tagline: Give an ensemble room to breathe.
modules.description: Focus gives one group member the turn; Ensemble coordinates eligible members. Applies to real group chats, not solo play or Matrix.

controls.name: group_mode
controls.label: Group turn ownership
controls.description: Group mode: Inactive in solo chats and Matrix. Focus: one card owns the turn. Ensemble: the present eligible cast may interact.

modules.name: Black Veil
modules.tagline: Decide what the reader can know.
modules.description: Open the backstage, permit scoped dramatic irony, or keep discovery external. Protected modes suppress spoiler-bearing panels.

controls.name: veil_mode
controls.label: Reader access
controls.description: Protected modes suppress spoiler-bearing modules without changing their saved switches. Strict overrides close/first-person NPC POV.

controls.name: veil_allowance
controls.label: Permitted glimpse / reveal scope
controls.description: Optional scope for Dramatic irony, e.g. the guard is worried about a public inspection. Does not authorize invented secrets. Strict does not allow private/offscreen glimpses.

modules.name: Field Rules: RPG Lite
modules.description: Optional diceless costs or player-supplied d6 checks. Roll a real die after stakes and a check ID are established; no dice tool is included.

controls.name: rpg_mode
controls.label: Resolution mode
controls.description: New uncertain actions become attempts. Player d6 needs real external dice and a matching check ID; Diceless makes no randomness claim.
options: Player d6 — declared stakes, external roll

modules.name: Cut & Carry
modules.tagline: Move to the part that matters.
modules.description: Recognize explicit Cut, Montage, and Downtime commands while leaving uncertain outcomes and important choices unresolved.

controls.name: cut_carry
controls.label: Recognize transition commands
controls.description: Explicit [Cut: ...], [Montage: ...], [Downtime: ...] only. Does not enable automatic time skips.

modules.name: Narrative Mass
modules.description: Set a prose word aim, choose Free-Flow, or use Pulse for responsive turns. These are model instructions, not a guaranteed length limit.

controls.name: words_target
controls.label: Narrative Mass
controls.description: Final-scene word aim when both Free-Flow and Pulse are off. Usual range ±15%; upper bound is the ceiling. Includes dialogue/thought text; excludes trace and Dock. Thin or agency-limited turns may be shorter.

controls.name: narrative_mass_free_flow
controls.label: Free-Flow Narrative Mass
controls.description: On: scene-selected length without a numeric target. Off: use Narrative Mass unless Pulse is on. Pulse takes precedence over both.

controls.name: pulse_mode
controls.label: Pulse Mode — Responsive Turn Size
controls.description: Opt-in: one reaction or several paragraphs, ending at a meaningful handoff. Overrides Narrative Mass and Free-Flow while On; leaves interface modules active.

modules.name: Sensor Perspective
modules.description: Set the narration perspective independently of the operator’s input voice. First-person input does not transfer control of your avatar.

controls.name: camera_lens
controls.label: Sensor Perspective
controls.description: Select first-, second-, or third-person narrative perspective.

modules.name: Style Kernel
modules.tagline: Change the voice, keep the character.
modules.description: Separate the literary frame from character-colored prose. Perspective and voice are independent controls.

controls.name: prose_voice
controls.label: Prose Voice
controls.description: EiDOS literary framing or character-colored narration. Independent of POV, cognition route, and paragraph structure.

modules.name: No-Clone Protocol
modules.tagline: Give the scene somewhere new to go.
modules.description: Instructional checks discourage repeating the same beat and framing. Model, context, summaries, and character-card wording still matter.

modules.name: Identity Anchor // Pronouns & Gender
modules.description: Choose persona defaults, he/him, she/her, or they/them. They/them retains the persona’s stated gender; explicit OOC corrections take precedence.

controls.name: operator_identity
controls.label: Operator Identity Anchor
controls.description: Optional fictional-persona pronouns/gender grounding. One selection prevents conflicting toggles; Follow persona is the default. A newer explicit OOC correction takes precedence. They/them preserves stated gender.

modules.name: Subject Resistance
modules.tagline: Affection does not erase a spine.
modules.description: Tune how readily the cast yields without replacing established motives or personality.

controls.name: contestant_friction
controls.label: Subject Resistance
controls.description: Controls how readily characters yield while preserving their established personality.

modules.name: Affective Integrity
modules.description: Preserve personality, conflicting motives, and character-specific responses as relationships develop.

modules.name: Epistemic Resistance
modules.description: Keep character knowledge tied to evidence and in-world access rather than automatic agreement with every claim.

modules.name: Prior Existence Protocol
modules.description: Ground NPCs in histories and commitments that exist independently of the operator.

modules.name: Black Hat : Antagonist Integrity
modules.description: Optional antagonist profiles organize targets, methods, reach, and restraints. Enable intentionally for a suitable story.

controls.name: antagonist_targets
controls.label: Antagonist targets
controls.description: Exact character/faction names. Blank preserves Integrity only; no profile is applied to the whole cast.

controls.name: antagonist_method
controls.label: Operating method
controls.description: Applies only to named targets, subordinate to established characterization.

controls.name: antagonist_reach
controls.label: Reach ceiling
controls.description: A ceiling, never new powers, allies or access.

controls.name: antagonist_restraints
controls.label: Restraints and vulnerabilities
controls.description: Optional limits/commitments to apply to named antagonists; no retroactive erasure of canon.

modules.name: CYOA - Fork Protocol
modules.description: Offer feasible operator-owned actions with short possible consequences. Suggestions do not become canon until selected.

controls.name: cyoa_enabled
controls.label: Fork Protocol
controls.description: On: offer five operator-owned choices at a valid handoff. Off: never offer or execute numbered Fork choices. Keep this carrier block enabled; use this switch instead.

modules.name: Affective Conductance
modules.tagline: Track a bond, not a verdict.
modules.description: A primary-pair affinity meter with Sparks and Grudge. Group routing can suspend it; attachment is not agreement.

controls.name: affinity_multiplier
controls.label: Affective Conductance Rate
controls.description: Maximum per-turn Affinity shift; Sparks and Grudge remain momentum counters.

modules.name: Memory Spine (Deep Archive)
modules.description: Deep Archive records current continuity and open threads inside chat history. It is not an external database or unlimited memory.

modules.name: Relationship Mesh
modules.description: Keep ensemble attachment and friction distinct rather than flattening the cast into a single score.

modules.name: Latent Threads
modules.description: Track unresolved pressures with causal limits rather than treating every loose end as an immediate twist.

modules.name: EiDOS Core Trace
modules.description: Optional compact, noncanonical reader commentary from the core interface voice.

modules.name: Kazz Parasite Feed
modules.description: An independent, optional commentary voice. His feed does not authorize changes to story canon.

modules.name: Vocal Chambers // Dialogue Cards
modules.tagline: Let each voice leave a signature.
modules.description: Speaker labels, a small waveform, and pastel-to-character gradients frame tagged dialogue. The display depends on valid generated tags.

controls.name: dialogue_frames
controls.label: Vocal Chambers — Dialogue Cards
controls.description: Separate present spoken dialogue into EiDOS panels. Coexists with speaker colors and Kinetic effects; does not style every quoted string.

modules.name: Subject Status HUD
modules.tagline: A readable inventory of the present.
modules.description: Optional established-state display for physical condition, equipment, inventory, and active effects.
